spearman.name: Spearman
spearman.description: Sturdy front-line fighter with a long spear. Hits hard up close and at reach 2.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Fragile but shoots far. Cannot hit targets on adjacent squares.

mage.name: Mage
mage.description: Powerful spellcaster. If a side's mage falls, that side loses the battle.
